additionalProperties.description: One tracker / code-host account (global scope only).

oneOf.description: Bearer token from "Sign in with browser" (device flow), refreshed before it expires.

auth.description: Default per kind: jira cloud `basic`, dc `bearer`, redmine `api_key`, github/gitlab/gitea `token`, bitbucket `basic` (account `email` + API token; `bearer` for repository/workspace access tokens), linear raw API key (`bearer` for OAuth).

base_url.description: github: `https://api.github.com`; gitlab: `https://gitlab.com`; linear: `https://api.linear.app`; bitbucket: `https://api.bitbucket.org/2.0`; required for jira/redmine/gitea.

oneOf.description: Bitbucket Cloud: code host only (its issue tracker was removed in August 2026).

Tracker served by a process (KPP) plugin; `plugin` names it (PLUGINS §9).

plugin.description: `plugin_tracker` / `plugin_codehost`: id of the plugin whose `[provider]` serves this account.

confirm_quit_with_running.description: Ask before quitting while Claude is working or waiting for you.

prompt_templates.conflicts: The rebase of {branch} onto {onto} stopped at commit {step} of {total} with conflicts, listed in {file}. Resolve them, `git add` the files, then run `GIT_EDITOR=true git rebase --continue` until the rebase is done. Do not push.
prompt_templates.feedback: The review of {pr.url} left feedback, collected in {file}. Address each item (or say why not), run the tests, and commit the fixes. Do not push.
prompt_templates.review: Review PR {pr.url} ({pr.head} → {pr.base}). Focus on correctness, tests and risks. Do not edit files.
prompt_templates.ticket: Work on {ticket.key}: {ticket.title}. The full ticket is in {run}/ticket.md. Read it, then propose a short plan before editing.

hook_transport.description: SessionStart always uses a command hook.

ide_bridge.description: Claude IDE bridge: Claude sessions see Kelta as their IDE (ARCHITECTURE §8.5).

mcp.description: Kelta MCP server for Claude sessions.

min_version.description: Semver; older → warning, hooks still attempted.

external.description: Launched outside Kelta (the template's editor pane becomes a shell).

review_args.description:
The diff editor's arguments: appended for review sessions and used by Review diff on own work
items, e.g. `["-c","DiffviewOpen {range}"]` (`{range}` = `<remote>/<base>` for own items, merge
base to working tree; `<remote>/<base>...HEAD` for review checkouts). Empty: `git diff` in a shell.

env.description: Environment added to every session of the project (project/repo files).

bindings.description:
ActionId → chords. Overrides only: unlisted actions use the platform defaults of the
ActionId catalog (`ui/src/lib/gen/actions.ts`); `[]` unbinds.

prefix_bindings.description: ActionId → single key after the prefix.

auto_nvidia.description: NVIDIA proprietary → dmabuf off + explicit sync off.

review_requested.description: Keeps review subscriptions polling in background.

oauth.description: OAuth apps used by "Sign in with browser" (device flow, GitHub and GitLab).

client_ids.description: Client id of the GitHub OAuth App or application id of the GitLab application, per host (`github.com`, `gitlab.com`, `gitlab.acme.example`). Public values; a host without one only offers pasted tokens.

dev_paths.description: Unpacked plugin dirs loaded in dev mode (global only; still require grants).

range.description:
`first-last`: each work item gets the next free block of 10 (`KELTA_PORT`, `KELTA_PORT_1..9`);
empty = no ports.

ignore_globs.description:
Paths (globs) the Ready for review chip counts as generated, next to `linguist-generated`
and `-diff` attributes.

ticket_key_regex.description: Linked tickets regex over branch + title.

command.description: Shell: run this then stay interactive.

default.font_family: JetBrains Mono, Menlo, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

confirm_multiline_paste.description: Only when bracketed paste is off.

font_family.default: JetBrains Mono, Menlo, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

history_log.description: Append scrolled-off lines (plain text) to an on-disk log per session: search + restore.

history_log_total_mb.description: Cap of all session logs; oldest files are deleted first.

renderer.description: auto = webgl on macOS, dom on Linux.

scrollback.description: Rust-model scrollback lines per session kind.

oneOf.description: PTYs in the app process: quitting ends them.
PTYs in `keltad`: sessions survive quit and re-attach on the next start.

items.description:
A declarative tool. Every field except `id` has a default so `{ id = "x", enabled = false }`
disables an inherited entry (by_id merge).

id.description: `[a-z0-9-]`; plugin tools are namespaced `<plugin>/<id>` by the host.

Refocusing a work item after this many minutes away shows the return strip (`next:` note,

scratch_branch_template.description:
Branch of a scratch work item (New work item, `kelta-ctl start --task`); `{slug}` = slug of
the task's first line.

env_template.description:
Worktree file ending in `.kelta` (e.g. `.env.kelta`), rendered at start work to the same path
without `.kelta` (`{port}`, `{port.1}`…`{port.9}`); an existing different file is kept.

include.description: Globs copied from the main checkout; `.worktreeinclude` patterns appended.

setup.description: Each run in the visible setup pane.

teardown.description: Run in a visible pane on Finish, in the worktree; failure stops the Finish.
